name: The Exchange
description: A neutral merchant-spy faction appears near the galactic core: a vast trading station that funds the underdog of every war, runs high-skill agents against the strong, sells stolen intelligence, hires pirates in its own name and guards its system with two patrol fleets. Trace its money and its spies, have the council sanction it, and blockade or destroy the station to close it down.
